name: ecommerce-invoices-and-documents-filament
description: The filing cabinet: a Filament panel over the documents a sale produces, their frozen lines, the series they are numbered from, the credit notes that correct them and the attempts to deliver them.
features: There is no create page, no edit page and no delete action anywhere in this package, and the suite fails if one arrives
A document is corrected by raising a credit note against it, and a draft is discarded by being voided; both write an audit row
Every write is a published domain action, so nothing in this package reaches Eloquent to save, update or delete
Every write re-reads the document through FindDocument, so the guard runs against the row rather than against the screen
A move the document cannot make from where it stands is not offered, and asking for one anyway is refused rather than done
Every mutation reports which of three things happened: recorded, already recorded, or refused and why
All twenty refusal reasons the domain publishes have a sentence, and a twenty-first would fail the suite rather than a merchant
A refused delivery says whether the attempt row was written, because an unbound transport leaves one and a missing address does not
Every total is summed from the document's own frozen lines on read, and no column on any screen holds one
Every amount carries the currency it was frozen with, and no screen prints a currency symbol of its own
Tax is shown per line and summarised per distinct rate, because a document stating only a gross total is not a valid VAT invoice
A document with no number renders as not numbered, which for a proforma is correct rather than missing
A proforma is issued without a series, because it may not be filed under a fiscal one
The series select is searched and bounded, never a pluck of the table at form-build time
A series' continuity is reconciled on read, and a number unaccounted for is named as an external event rather than a cleanup
A gapless series is not offered the burn control, and burning one anyway is refused rather than done
A retention window the host never configured renders as unknown rather than as none
No renderer configured is stated on the record as the fact it is, and the document is still numbered, filed, listed and deliverable
The buyer's email is on the record screen and on no listing
Viewing a document is answered by the domain's CustodyPolicy, and every other Filament ability is forced closed by name
Another merchant's reference and one that does not exist raise the same exception on every screen
